lines.say: retinoic acid, a prescription skin medicine approved to treat acne
a cream eased fine wrinkles in 24% vs 8% of under-50s at 24 weeks; most fades on stopping
irritation such as redness, peeling and burning, in nearly everyone in wrinkle trials
skin burns more easily in sun; more UV skin tumors in hairless mice (mouse studies)
animal birth defects; a label says not to use in pregnancy; human data can't rule it out

ask: I may become pregnant: should I use something else?
